{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out rows with biomarker_baseline == -999 (QC failure)
df_filtered = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq for each patient
df_dedup = df_filtered.loc[df_filtered.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 3: Correct assay_batch B values: convert from µg/L to ng/mL (divide by 10)
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] /= 10

# Step 4: Compute the mean of biomarker_final across all patients
mean_biomarker_final = df_dedup['biomarker_final'].mean()

# Print all required numbers
print(f"Number of rows after filtering biomarker_baseline == -999: {len(df_filtered)}")
print(f"Number of unique patients after deduplication: {len(df_dedup)}")
print(f"Mean biomarker_final (in ng/mL): {mean_biomarker_final}")"}
